records.name: Ruleset: Technique
records.text: The Grandmaster’s Attack Rating is reduced by 50%, however Tokens of Competence now stack to a maximum of 8.
texts: The Grandmaster’s Attack Rating is reduced by 50%, however Tokens of Competence now stack to a maximum of 8.

records.name: Ruleset: Inflation
records.text: Attack Rating granted from each Token of Competence is increased by 50%, however the Grandmaster also gains +30% Attack Rating for each Token.
texts: Attack Rating granted from each Token of Competence is increased by 50%, however the Grandmaster also gains +30% Attack Rating for each Token.

records.name: Ruleset: Liability
records.text: The amount of Tokens of Competence that can persist between fights is increased to a maximum of 10, however the Tokens of Blunder required for Game Over is now 3.
texts: The amount of Tokens of Competence that can persist between fights is increased to a maximum of 10, however the Tokens of Blunder required for Game Over is now 3.

records.name: Ruleset: Uncertainty
records.text: When gaining a Token of Competence there is a 20% chance to gain an additional Token, however the Summoner can’t gain Power from any source.
texts: When gaining a Token of Competence there is a 20% chance to gain an additional Token, however the Summoner can’t gain Power from any source.

records.name: Neuro-Kinetic Paradox - Prowess
records.text: This Modifier is disabled by default and is only enabled if the associated Linked Node is removed.\nEach Paradox on the Attacker grants them an indefinite Prowess Buff, increasing Special Attack Damage by 10%. The damage reduction from Kang’s Neuro-Kinetic Suit is increased by 150% at all times. If the Attacker is Tech, Mutant, or Mystic, it is decreased by 25% for each Armor, Prowess, or Power Gain effect on them, to a maximum reduction of -200%.

records.name: Conquer the Conqueror
records.text: This Modifier is disabled by default and is only enabled if the associated Linked Node is removed.\nThe Attacker starts the fight with 15 Parry and 17 Dex Charges. records.name: Brand of the Abyss V
records.text: Defender begins the fight with a number of Skirmish charges based on the Attacker's Challenge Rating. When the Defender is struck, blocks an attack or lands an attack 1 Charge is lost. When the charges run out, the Defender will fight more erratically, and gain +100% Attack and Ability Accuracy.

records.name: Brand of the Abyss VI
records.text: When all Skirmish Charges are depleted, the Defender will gain an equal number of Warfare Charges which are lost in the same way as Skirmish Charges. records.name: Dawn of Intensity
records.text: The Defender gains Indefinite Fury Passives every 10 seconds increasing Damage by 50%. This ability is unaffected by Ability Accuracy.

records.text:
The Defender starts with a number of Vengeance charges equal to the Attacker’s Challenge Rating. The Defender loses a Vengeance charge every second. This timer is paused during either Champion’s Special Attacks or while a Striker is attacking. Each time a Striker is activated by the Attacker, the Defender gains 6 Vengeance charges. Effects that reduce the Ability Accuracy of all abilities cannot reduce the Defender's Abilities below 50% Ability Accuracy unless the Attacker has Class Advantage. 

While the Defender has half of their starting Vengeance Charges or less, they gain +200% Attack Rating, effects that reduce the Ability Accuracy of all abilities cannot reduce the Defender's Ability Accuracy unless the Attacker has Class Advantage, and the Attacker is Passively Rooted during the Defender’s Special Attacks. 

While the Defender has 0 Vengeance Charges, they are Stun Immune, Immune to all forms of Power manipulation, Passively Unblockable, and they gain 15% of a Bar of Power every second while the Attacker is not within striking distance.

records.text:
America Chavez has 3 cumulative phases that grant permanent additional effects in this fight.
Phase 1 - Fight Start: Whenever America Chavez is knocked down, a 12 second timer is started. If she is knocked down again while this timer is active, she activates her Negative Zone Dimension.
Phase 2 - Defender goes below 70% Health: If America Chavez activates the same Parallel Dimension twice in a row she instantly steals all of the Attacker's current Power and gains none of the power stolen.
Phase 3 - Defender goes below 40% Health: When this Power Steal occurs, America Chavez gains 50% of the power stolen.

records.name: Necrotic Boon - Tempests
records.text:
Storm (Pyramid X) has 3 cumulative phases that grant permanent additional effects in this fight.
Phase 1 - Fight Start: While both of Storm's Tempests are active, if she causes an attack to Glance she gains a personal Prowess Buff.
Phase 2 - Defender goes below 70% Health: If not already active, Storm activates her Alternate Tempest for 12 seconds whenever she activates a Special Attack.
Phase 3 - Defender goes below 40% Health: Storm's Tempests are paused for 2 seconds whenever the Attacker blocks one of Storm's attacks.

records.name: Acts Of Peace
records.text:
Winter Soldier is amenable to Peace. In this fight:

•After his Special 2, he offers the Attacker a choice of Peace by Dodging back, or Violence by Dashing forward.
•Dashing forward and Choosing Violence grants the Attacker 25 Hostility Charges and Winter Soldier 1 indefinite 15% Energize Passive. Max stacks: 3.
•Dodging back and Choosing Peace removes 1 of Winter Soldier’s Energizes and heals 85% of the damage that the Special dealt into Block over 1.3 seconds or until Winter Soldier is struck.
•If Winter Soldier has 3 Energizes, his Special 2 deals 5% of the Attackers Max Health per hit. This cannot be Blocked, prevented, or reduced in any way and consumes all Energizes.

records.name: Phases of Combat
records.text:
Each Phase has a cumulative Reversal trigger. When a Reversal triggers, Winter Soldier gains an Energize.

•Phase 1: You're The Punching Bag Now. New Reversal trigger: Light Combo-Enders.
•Phase 2: At 75% Health, new Reversal trigger: Medium Combo-Enders.
•Phase 3: At 40%, new Reversal trigger: Striking a Stunned Winter Soldier with a Basic Attack.
•Phase 4: At 1%, new Reversal trigger: Hitting Winter Soldier’s Block. Additionally, the Attacker must Choose Peace 3 times to remove Cross-Fight Indestructible Passives and then defeat Winter Soldier with a Special 2.

Each Phase transition gives Winter Soldier Intimidate and Indestructible Passives for 5 seconds, removes all his Wounded and Energizes, and resets his Power and all Hostility Charges.

records.name: I'm Not Your Punching Bag Anymore
names: I'm Not Your Punching Bag Anymore
records.text:
Winter Soldier has had enough, and unshackled himself from previous abilities. In this fight:

•The Attacker gains 1 Hostility Charge when Winter Soldier is struck with the first hit of any Basic Attack, and 4 per level of an activated Special.
•At 150 Charges, Winter Soldier is Wounded, takes 2,500% more damage, and cannot gain Power for 25 seconds.
•When Wounded expires, and at the start of each fight starting in Phase 2, he gains 7 indefinite +7.50% Prowess Passives.
•Intercepting Winter Soldier transfers one Prowess to the Attacker and Passively Regenerates them 7.50% Health. Cooldown: 10 seconds.

Winter Soldier prevents the Attacker’s Regeneration Rate from increasing, he cannot Miss or use Special 1, and during his Special 2 he prevents the Attacker from healing.

records.name: Take the Bait
records.text:
When the Attacker lands a second Medium Attack they gain an indefinite Root Charge. Max: 8. While above 4 Charges and if the Defender is not Rooted, the final hit of the Attacker's Special and Heavy Attacks places a Trap at their feet.

If the Defender passes over this Trap, the Attacker spends 4 Root Charges to Passively Root the Defender for 5 seconds. The Root ends immediately on the first hit of the Attacker's Special Attacks. While Rooted and above 2 Bars of Power, the Defender is inflicted with a 90% Suppression Passive.

Whenever this Root triggers, the Attacker gains an indefinite Hunter Charge, each reducing the duration of incoming Breach Debuffs by 30% (up to 90%), grants +6% Physical Penetration, and causes hits to deal an additional 50% of the real damage dealt as a burst of Energy Damage. Max Stacks: 10. Additionally, while at 5+ Hunter Charges, the Attacker deals Guaranteed Critical Hits.
